headline: HOMEBODY's shop gets shelves
lede: The buy catalog is no longer a wall of sixteen tiny cards: four category shelves — HOME, FUN, DECOR, SPECIAL — flip open with [ and ] on the keyboard or a tap on a phone, and every card is now big and reachable by digit. Another game code shipped straight to the shelf, proven by a harness that learned it can fail.

notes.text: Buy mode opens on the HOME shelf; ] walks HOME→FUN→DECOR→SPECIAL and back, and each shelf remembers the card you last picked on it. The Spare Room, cat and child counter keys land you on SPECIAL automatically.
Digits 1-9 now pick within the open shelf — all sixteen items reachable, where before anything past card 9 was keyboard-orphaned on a phone.

peoplecheck is at 308 gates including a new STORES section (the four shelves cover the catalog exactly, selection always sits on the open shelf, purchases bill the same laws); the shelf law mutant went red exactly where it should and back. Real-Chrome drive 48/48, including gold-pixel proof of the open tab.

The idle-builder ladder ran end to end for real: the warden's target was held by the live slot-b lane, the queue was empty, flagship gaps all owned — so the never-dry stage picked the weakest title on the shelf by score and shipped a real mechanic from its oldest unowned gap.
